args.title: Validate TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES format on startup
args.body:
File: src/config.ts

This change adds validation to the TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES environment variable to stop the service from starting if the token lifetime is set with an invalid format like "12h"; it should be a number of minutes like 720. This prevents misleading expiry times and unexpected sign-outs.

args.title: Add name search filter to reports list
args.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

Add a query parameter to the GET /reports endpoint allowing filtering reports by name, enabling users to find reports by partial or full report names without paging through all reports.

args.title: Honor quality values in Accept-Language header
args.body:
File: src/api/uploads.ts

Change the language selection in the API to honor the quality values (q values) in Accept-Language header properly, so that responses come in the most preferred supported language rather than just the first supported language in the list.

label: bug
file: src/config.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES setting is parsed as an integer number of minutes. The service should reject values like "12h" rather than silently interpreting them as 12 minutes. This issue is fixed by adding startup validation for this setting.

label: question
file: none
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The health check endpoint returns 200 even when the status is "degraded" (such as when the job queue is busy). This is intended to distinguish between degraded and down states, but it is unclear if your load balancer should treat degraded as healthy or remove the instance from rotation.

label: feature
file: src/api/reports.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

This proposes adding a name filter query parameter to the reports listing endpoint. This will allow users to search reports by their names to find specific saved reports more easily.

label: docs
file: src/api/auth.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The API docs should clarify the password rules for reset confirmation. The source code enforces a minimum password length of 10 characters in the validation schema used in the /password-reset/confirm endpoint.

label: bug
file: src/api/uploads.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The API currently ignores the quality values in the Accept-Language header, leading to responses sometimes being sent in a less preferred language. This fix proposes honoring the q values in the language negotiation for better localization fidelity.
